name: 2B
designation: Official designation: YoRHa No. 2 Type B
paragraphs: An all-purpose combat android deployed to Earth as a member of the automated infantry squad YoRHa. She excels at close-range combat with a variety of weapons, while her accompanying Pod provides support for ranged attacks.
Her combat visor means her eyes are rarely seen. YoRHa members have no names; they are known only by their designations.
Although regulations forbid emotions, individual personalities vary. Even among her fellow soldiers, 2B is particularly calm and composed.
label: 2B

name: 9S
designation: Official designation: YoRHa No. 9 Type S
tagline: A fleeting kindness, and a soul.
paragraphs: A YoRHa unit specializing in reconnaissance, particularly gathering information through hacking. Although he has offensive capabilities, combat is not his strong suit.
Among the members of YoRHa, he stands out for his expressive emotions and gentle personality.
label: 9S

name: A2
designation: Official designation: YoRHa Type A No. 2
tagline: A vortex of the past and hatred.
paragraphs: The Type A is a YoRHa prototype specializing in close-range combat, no longer in active service. These units were used to develop the production models that followed, including 2B and 9S.
A2 is a woman of few words who always operates alone.
label: A2

name: Pod 042 / 153
paragraphs: Support units issued as standard equipment to YoRHa soldiers. Primarily equipped with weapons for ranged attacks, they also assist with movement.
Pods communicate with Command and exchange tactical information between units. Pod 042 accompanies 2B, while Pod 153 accompanies 9S.
label: Pod 042 / 153

name: YoRHa Commander
paragraphs: The officer in charge of the Bunker, a base in satellite orbit, and commander of the entire YoRHa force.
Her position demands a stern demeanor, but she seems concerned about 2B and 9S. She also appears to share a history with the YoRHa prototype A2.
label: YoRHa Commander

name: Operator 6O / 21O
paragraphs: Communications operators stationed in the Bunker. They relay orders to YoRHa soldiers on the ground and analyze incoming information.
Personalities vary between units: 6O, who supports 2B, is cheerful, while 21O, assigned to 9S, is reserved and composed.
label: Operator 6O / 21O

name: Adam
paragraphs: A mysterious, highly intelligent young man who wears glasses. Usually composed, he can be mercilessly cruel in pursuit of his goals.

second.name: Eve
paragraphs: Adam’s younger twin brother. In contrast to his brother, he is hot-tempered and gives little thought to things. He adores Adam.

label: Adam / Eve

name: Pascal
paragraphs: Despite being a machine lifeform, Pascal is a pacifist who dislikes conflict. Together with like-minded machines, he searches for a path to peace.
He is highly intelligent and takes an interest in the history of both humanity and machine lifeforms.
label: Pascal

name: Devola / Popola
paragraphs: Older-model androids living at the Resistance camp. They know that units of their own model once ran out of control, and they carry a sense of guilt over it.
Unusually for androids, their model is capable of consuming alcohol.
label: Devola / Popola

name: Emil
paragraphs: A character who also appeared in the previous game. After many long years, most of his memories have been lost.
label: Emil

name: Anemone
paragraphs: The leader of the Resistance, who descended to Earth long before YoRHa and continues to fight across the land.
Strong-willed and caring toward her comrades, she is a natural leader. She provides the protagonists with a wealth of useful information.
label: Anemone
